integrity: Proof derived from simultaneous eigenspaces, orbit-stabilizer and dominated convergence. Exhaustive small-prime-field verification is corroborative, not a proof of infinite behavior.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns fixed prime-power field size, matrices of size 4m, two idempotents of rank 2m, and the conditional law given commutation. Exact finite formulas apply more broadly. Publication priority is best-knowledge; earlier implicit enumeration is a residual risk.
title: A discrete theta law for product ranks of commuting finite-field idempotents
